title: Round a price list with ROUND
objective: Use ROUND with 2, 0 and -1 digits to round raw prices, and total the rounded prices.
instructions: Column B holds raw prices in KES after a currency conversion. In C2:C5 round each price to 2 decimal places. In D2:D5 round to the nearest whole shilling. In E2:E5 round to the nearest KES 10. In D7 add up the whole-shilling prices from D2:D5 (not the raw prices).
hints: ROUND takes two arguments: =ROUND(number, digits). The first is the cell to round, for example B2.
2 digits keeps two decimals, 0 gives a whole number, and -1 rounds to the nearest 10.
For D7, add the rounded prices with =SUM(D2:D5). The total of rounded prices is not the same as the rounded total of raw prices.
